Sandbox_PhunServer2Cron_EnableCron_toolt: Untick to stop all scheduled jobs from running. Your job file is left alone.
Sandbox_PhunServer2Cron_SeedDefaults_too: When no job file exists, write one containing a five minute mod-update check. Untick if you would rather start from an empty schedule.
Sandbox_PhunServer2Cron_EnableModWatch_t: When ticked, mod-update checks poll Steam and trigger a shutdown if any of your workshop mods have been updated. Untick to disable without removing the job.
Sandbox_PhunServer2Cron_RestartDelayMinu: Minutes of notice players get before the server shuts down for a mod update
Sandbox_PhunServer2Cron_PollOnDisconnect: Also check for mod updates whenever a player leaves. An empty server is the cheapest time to restart.
